pressure_translation: Only Pip is captured first; he discovers Rolzen inside Neith’s captivity and the bond grows through diamond-shield healing, not co-capture from the outside.
Pip’s geode shell and gemstone wings are immediately tested by zombie Mack, preventing the transformation from becoming a clean triumph.
Pip’s roar physically crushes the witnesses but reaches Rylos as proof that Pip still loves him, which becomes the opening for the lemon-sun countershot.
The dogs remain bored or mildly interested during the geode-shell crisis, quietly signaling that this event belongs to Pip’s deeper pattern rather than to simple catastrophe.
